source_replay.method: Reviewed local copies made under the assigned scratch root; sealed source files were not modified.

reviewed_claims.scope: Finite simple G, |V(G)|=2k+2, k>=2, tau(G)>=3, arbitrary marked W containing a non-isolated vertex; q_(k+1)(G,W)<=q_k(G,W).
decisive_checks: Verified the two-part split at a non-isolated mark and checked its exact residual orders.
At exact 2k residual order, the deleted pair is {w,z}; all crossing edges meet z, so at most one residual edge would imply a cover of size at most two.
The order-(2k+1) arbitrary-mark reduction preserves the >=2-edge condition in its exact 2k residual case.
Marked incidence count has at least k mark-preserving deletions per upper set and at most k extensions per lower set when order <=2k.
dependencies: E993-BINOMIAL-DIFFERENCE-CATALAN-FLOOR is not needed for this graph claim.

reviewed_claims.scope: Ordinary trees with p>=3, |V(T)|=2p+2, x(T)+2<=p; every original leaf summand is nonpositive, and therefore the fixed favorable-leaf sum is nonpositive.
decisive_checks: Cover-three decomposition gives Delta_r(T)>0 for every 0<=r<=p-2; checked r=0, r=1, and the Catalan ratio bound for r>=2.
Integer zero extension gives Delta_alpha(T)=-1, so x(T) exists and the early-descent contradiction is valid.
For each original leaf, alpha(T-{v,s})=alpha(T)-1 and tau(H)=tau(T)-1>=3.
Every component of H is an original support branch; tau(H)>=3 ensures a nontrivial branch and thus a non-isolated marked root.
The marked-count difference equals the original tagged leaf summand; the fixed strict selector and duplicate-support leaves are preserved.
dependencies: E993-BINOMIAL-DIFFERENCE-CATALAN-FLOOR at the stated integer ranks.
E993-GRAPH-FIRST-WIDE-SHARP-CLASSIFICATION only at its exact first-wide order.

limitations: Informal mathematical audit only; no Lean build or kernel award.
No conclusion for parent orders greater than 2p+2.
No refutation or proof of the complete all-order lower-region aggregate.
